outgoing.name: France
outgoing.excerpt: During the campaign of 1805 against France, Arakcheyev worked on supplying the army with enough artillery ammunition.

outgoing.name: Nightingale
outgoing.excerpt: Arakcheyev even ordered the hanging of all cats, on account of his fondness for nightingales.
